Trump downplays AI risks, cites competition with China

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has stated that he does not see an urgent need to regulate artificial intelligence (AI) development, expressing concern that such checks could cede an advantage to China. He described potential AI risks as "things that won't happen." Trump's remarks suggest a focus on maintaining a competitive edge over China in AI technology rather than prioritizing immediate regulatory measures to mitigate hypothetical future dangers.
